Analysis

Era 7 of 8

2011 to 2021: From Libya to Syria

Opened by: Libya intervention 2011, Syria vetoes from October 2011.

Longest texts (median 1,865 words). Sanctions in 45%, women in 59%, civilians in 38%. Russia (22) and China (11) lead the vetoes. The US and Russia vote alike on 14% of contested votes.

651resolutions
59per year
88%adopted unanimously
26vetoed drafts
48%under Chapter VII

Where the Council looked

Region of the situationShare
Africa52%
Middle East16%
Europe5%
Asia7%
Americas3%
Thematic8%
Institutional4%
Other4%

What rose in the texts

Subjects whose share of resolutions grew by 5 points or more on the previous era.

  • Women, peace and security: 23% to 59%
  • Sexual violence: 9% to 36%
  • Human rights: 35% to 62%
  • Children and armed conflict: 21% to 48%
  • Protection of civilians: 13% to 38%
  • Refugees and displacement: 22% to 45%

Vetoes

26 vetoed drafts. No votes by permanent members on them: USSR / Russia 22, United States 4, China 11. 17 further drafts failed for lack of votes.
